{{Quote|Three fluffy hotcakes prepared just the way they make 'em on the red-water moon in the Panna system. Served fresh off the robo-griddle with bantha butter and carbosyrup.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Panna cakes''' were a breakfast dish consisting of fluffy [[hotcake]]s that could be cooked on a [[robo-griddle]]. The [[Cake/Legends|cakes]] were served with [[Bantha butter/Legends|bantha butter]] and [[carbosyrup]], and optionally, [[ettel nut]]s or [[Zoochberry/Legends|zoochberries]] could also be served with the dish.<ref name="DaD" />

The cakes were made and [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] on<ref name="DaD" /> [[Panna Prime]],<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Panna system/Legends|Panna system]]. The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served Panna [[Cake/Legends|cakes]] as part of its breakfast menu,<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>  The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who owned Dex's, [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] the cakes for 4.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Adding ettel [[Nut/Legends|nuts]] or [[Berry/Legends|zoochberries]] cost an additional credit. In the menu for the diner, Jettster claimed that he made his Panna cakes just the way they were produced on in the [[Panna system/Legends|Panna system]].<ref name="DaD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|At its most basic level, this thinking led to a number of puns&mdash;Panna cakes, Wol Cabasshews, Xizor salad, Sic-Six-layer cake, Tibanna split and Shili cheese dog among them&mdash;that are either inspired or stupid or both, depending on one's sense of humor.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Pun">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Panna cakes were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DaD" /> In his [[Star Wars: Blogs|StarWars.com blog]], Walker stated that the dish's name was a pun, as "panna cake" is similar to<ref name="Pun" /> the real-world [[Wikipedia:Pancake|pancake]].<ref name="Pancake">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pancake|text=Pancake|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20210917183335}}</ref>
